description_en: Create an asynchronous image translation job. Image translation includes capabilities such as OCR, text translation, and text backfill
description_zh: 创建异步图片翻译，图片翻译包含文字识别、文本翻译、文字回填等能力
kebab_example: aliyun alimt create-image-translate-task --url-list http://xxx,http://yyy --source-language zh --target-language en --extra '{"have_ocr":"false","without_text":"false","have_psd":"true","ignore_entity":"false"}' --client-token 1 --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageTranslateTask

parameters.help_en: The URLs of images for translation. Separate multiple image URLs with commas. The number of images cannot exceed 20
parameters.help_zh: 图片翻译链接，多张图片通过英文逗号分隔，图片数量不能超过20张
parameters.name: url_list

parameters.help_en: The source language of the image
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language for image translation
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en:
The following JSON format content contains optional parameters. You can omit any parameters you do not need.
Example JSON format:
```
{
  "have_ocr": "false",
  "without_text": "false",
  "have_psd": "true",
  "ignore_entity": "false"
}
```
- `have_ocr`: Controls whether to return OCR results. true: required, false: not required  
`without_text`: Controls whether to erase text from the image. true: required, false: not required  
`have_psd`: Controls whether to return editor data for rendering in the editor. true: required, false: not required  
`ignore_entity`: Specifies whether to ignore Named Entity Recognition. true: ignore, false: do not ignore
parameters.help_zh:
以下JSON内容格式，不关注的都可以不用传递，都是可选参数
样例JSON格式内容：
```
{
  "have_ocr": "false",
  "without_text": "false",
  "have_psd": "true",
  "ignore_entity": "false"
}
```
- `have_ocr`，控制是否返回 OCR 结果，true：需要，false：不需要
`without_text`，控制是否需要擦除图片中的文字，true：需要，false：不需要
`have_psd`，控制是否返回图片编辑器数据，渲染编辑器，true：需要，false：不需要
`ignore_entity`，是否忽略实体识别，true：忽略，false：不忽略
parameters.name: extra

parameters.help_en: Provides idempotency. Within 3 minutes, requests with the same value will take effect only once
parameters.help_zh: 提供幂等能力，3分钟内，相同的值只会生效一次
parameters.name: client_token
